mapper.sql: id, resource_type, resource_id, version, draft_revision, state, phase, generation, idempotency_key, error_code, error_message, attempts, next_attempt_at, deadline_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into ai_publication ( id, resource_type, resource_id, version, draft_revision, state, phase, generation, idempotency_key, deadline_at) values (#{id}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{version}, #{draftRevision}, 'VALIDATING', 'VALIDATING', #{generation}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{deadlineAt})
mapper.update: update ai_publication set lease_owner = #{worker}, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = now() where id in ( select id from ai_publication where state in ('VALIDATING', 'PREPARING', 'REGISTERING') and next_attempt_at <= now() and (lease_until is null or lease_until < now()) order by created_at limit #{limit} for update skip locked)
mapper.select: select from ai_publication where lease_owner = #{worker} and state in ('VALIDATING', 'PREPARING', 'REGISTERING') and lease_until > now() order by created_at
mapper.update: update ai_publication set lease_owner = #{worker}, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and state in ('VALIDATING', 'PREPARING', 'REGISTERING') and next_attempt_at <= now() and (lease_until is null or lease_until < now())

update ai_publication set lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and state in ('VALIDATING', 'PREPARING', 'REGISTERING') and lease_owner = #{worker} and lease_until > now()

update ai_publication set state = #{nextState}, phase = #{nextPhase}, error_code = #{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_message = #{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and state = #{expectedState} and lease_owner = #{owner} and lease_until > now()

update ai_publication set state = case when attempts + 1 >= 5 then 'FAILED' else state end, error_code = #{code}, error_message = #{message}, attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and state = #{expectedState} and lease_owner = #{owner} and lease_until > now()

update ai_publication set state = 'VALIDATING', phase = 'VALIDATING', error_code = null, error_message = null, attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = now(), deadline_at = now() + interval '60 seconds', lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and state = 'FAILED'

update ai_publication set state = 'FAILED', error_code = #{code}, error_message = #{message}, lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and state = #{expectedState} and lease_owner = #{owner} and lease_until > now()
mapper.insert: insert into ai_outbox ( id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, generation, event_type, payload) values (#{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{generation}, #{eventType}, cast(#{payloadJson} as jsonb)) on conflict (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, generation, event_type) do nothing
mapper.update: update ai_outbox set lease_owner = #{worker}, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), attempts = attempts + 1 where id in ( select id from ai_outbox where status = 'PENDING' and next_attempt_at <= now() and (lease_until is null or lease_until < now()) order by created_at limit #{limit} for update skip locked)
mapper.select: select id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, generation, event_type, payload, attempts from ai_outbox where lease_owner = #{worker} and status = 'PENDING' and lease_until > now() order by created_at
mapper.update: update ai_outbox set lease_owner = null, lease_until = null, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, status = case when attempts >= 8 then 'FAILED' else 'PENDING' end where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING' and lease_owner = #{worker} and lease_until > now()
